name: Sakai City Museum & Daisen Kofun View
nameJa: 堺市博物館・大仙陵古墳
description: Located within Daisen Park facing Emperor Nintoku's tomb, featuring VR exhibits of ancient keyhole kofun mounds, samurai swords, and Sen no Rikyu tea culture history.
notes: VR Kofun tour available at the museum theater.
notesJa: 【見どころ】仁徳天皇陵古墳（大仙陵古墳）に隣接し、巨大古墳のVR体験や千利休の茶の湯文化を学べます。
parkingJa: 【駐車場】大仙公園駐車場あり。

editorial.editorialSummary: Museum facing Nintoku Kofun featuring VR ancient mound tours and tea history.

en.name: Sakai City Museum & Daisen Kofun View
en.description: Located within Daisen Park facing Emperor Nintoku's tomb, featuring VR exhibits of ancient keyhole kofun mounds, samurai swords, and Sen no Rikyu tea culture history.

ja.name: 堺市博物館・大仙陵古墳
ja.description: 世界遺産・百舌鳥古墳群の中心に位置する博物館です。仁徳天皇陵古墳のVR空中散歩体験や、堺が生んだ茶の湯の大成者・千利休ゆかりの展示・茶室などを鑑賞できます。
